placedBecause: an artifact written by a run outside the test process

witness.recorder: subprocess.run(['./scripts/test.sh', '--filter', <function>]) with stdout and stderr captured, one process per case, and the captured output parsed for swift-testing's own verdict, started and finished lines. seam-arming.json records the exit code, the verdict line, the tests started and finished, and the elapsed seconds for every one.

armedBy: The population is its own control and it is not uniform: 11 of the 12 processes printed a verdict line and one did not. CASE-0461's trapping mutant produced zero verdict lines and is armed on its started line instead, which is the distinction the repair exists to make — under the pre-repair rule all 12 were one undifferentiated `exit != 0`.
